item.title: Chef Franco Ruiz Brings New Energy to the Plate at The Nickel in Denver
item.description: Though chef Franco Ruiz doesn’t have a television pedigree or fancy awards hanging on his apron, he’s one of the most talented kitchen artists in Denver. For the past seven years he has run Woodie Fisher at the Hilton Garden Inn Denver Union Station. In June, 2025, the chef also took on the culinary program […] The post Chef Franco Ruiz Brings New Energy to the Plate at The Nickel in Denver first appeared on DiningOut.
